_note: Banco Horizonte's login: a customer who opened an account signs in by presenting their PID.
Registered under the same Relying Party Service as the onboarding (bank-onboarding.json), as a
second intended use. TEST environment only, every identifier a placeholder.
One claim: the personal administrative number, which the bank keeps only as an HMAC under a key
of the demonstration's process (apps/demo-onboarding/src/customers.ts). It is optional in the PID
Rulebook, so a PID without it cannot be used to log in, and the page says so.

policy.name: Banco Horizonte — login with PID
policy.description: Recognises an existing customer from the personal administrative number in their PID. Nothing else is asked for.
